AC1 — PER-DIRECTORY TRIAGE VERDICT (re-run fresh at 2026-08-12 18:15:04 PDT, immediately after claim)

Five guards per directory: (1) empty; (2) uncommitted; (3) `rebar exists` exits 1 (no such
ticket); (4) zero open file handles under it (`lsof +D`); (5) mtime older than 30 minutes.

    id                    empty  committed  exists  age_min  open_handles  VERDICT
    0efe-9207-2706-43a3   yes    no         no       322     0             DEBRIS - remove
    2021-2ef0-e36f-44fc   yes    no         no      1095     0             DEBRIS - remove
    6f8a-45e5-d9ec-402c   yes    no         no      1094     0             DEBRIS - remove
    a109-e758-71bb-4371   yes    no         no      1103     0             DEBRIS - remove
    afe5-db0b-e9c5-45d8   yes    no         no      3309     0             DEBRIS - remove
    c827-81ee-a592-4d27   yes    no         no      1097     0             DEBRIS - remove
    d052-ad3f-23c1-4511   yes    no         no      1125     0             DEBRIS - remove
    fa38-670c-d8fc-4c22   yes    no         no      1099     0             DEBRIS - remove

All 8 pass all five guards. NONE is excluded. The youngest (0efe, 5h22m) is an order of
magnitude outside the 30-minute live-writer window, so no directory is plausibly a live
agent's mid-write state — the specific confusion this triage exists to rule out.

Corroborating evidence, independent of the guards above:

* The tracker's `git status --porcelain` is EMPTY (0 lines) even with all 8 present — the
  expected signature, since git cannot track empty directories. That is also why these are
  invisible in shared history and exist only in this clone.
* `rebar review-plan` emitted, unprompted, one warning per directory:
  "skipping ticket directory with no CREATE/SNAPSHOT event: <path> (debris of an
  interrupted write; safe to delete)" — rebar's own classifier agrees with this verdict for
  all 8, by name.
* The live-writer control: `lsof +D` on the tracker DOES show an active handle on an
  unrelated ticket (`874a-bda3-ee6f-45eb/...-SNAPSHOT.json`), confirming the check can
  actually observe a concurrent writer and is not vacuously returning zero.

Mechanism: `os.makedirs(ticket_dir)` succeeded and the process died before the first event
was atomically renamed in — agents interrupted by host sleeps, session-limit kills, and
shell-cap timeouts. The mtime clustering supports this: six of the eight fall inside a
95-minute band on 2026-08-11 (23:30-00:01), consistent with a single interruption episode.

Tracker HEAD at triage: f79a163d70895b0119e652a9c71380b0df8f4799
